datasets.name: IntCache1
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.id,p.boorowerid,p.numberofcredit,val_name,b.name,
       rest,duerest,interestrest,p.creditlineamount,h.penaltyrest,
       p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,p.qovid,
       cr.description crtype,b.phonenumber,p.annualyinterestrate,p.annualyoverduerate,p.annualypenaltyrate,
       dueinterestrest,p.purposeofcredit,cm_utils.Get_MainPlanPayment(p.id) odenilmeli,
       cm_utils.Get_MainPlanPayment(p.id)+ duerest + interestrest + dueinterestrest+h.penaltyrest fullrest,
       dueday,q.name qovluq,f.name filial,m.name mehsul,a.name meqed,e.name expert,r.description ehtiyyat,py.maxpaydate,
       case when dueday =1 then 0
        when py.maxpaydate=sbop.GET_DATE then 1  end as status,        
  b.pincode,b.boorowerid pasnum,b.address,cm_deca.GET_CUSTDATEOFBIRTH(p.boorowerid) dogum_tarixi,cm_deca.GET_CUSTPLACEOFBIRTH(p.boorowerid) dogum_yeri
FROM cm_active_credits p,
     cm_credittypes cr,
     cm_curr_state h,
     cm_boorowerinfo b,
     cm_qovluq q,
     filial_t f,
     avalute_t v,
     cm_mehsul m ,
     cm_aim_cred a,
     cm_expert e,
     cm_reserve_types r,
     (select creditid ,max(paydate) maxpaydate from cm_payments group by creditid) py
     
WHERE     p.id = h.creditid
      AND p.id = b.creditid
      AND p.id = py.creditid(+)
      AND p.qovid = q.id
      AND p.mehsulid=m.id
      AND h.reserveid=r.id
      AND p.aim_id=a.id
      AND p.expertid=e.id
      AND h.rest + h.duerest + h.interestrest + h.interestrest > 0
      AND h.dueday>0
      AND p.branchid = f.id
      AND p.currency = v.valute
      AND p.credittype = cr.id
     AND ((q.usname=user) or decode(user,'SMART',0,1)=0)
  











order by :title

datasets.name: ReportDelays
datasets.sql:
select 
g.filial,
g.tipi,
umumi_portfel "Ümumi portfel",
gecikmede_qaliq "Gecikmede olan portfel",
kredit_sayi "Gecikmede olan  kredit sayı",
umumi_par "Ümumi par",
par_ferq "Öten ayla muqaisede artış",
gecikmede_qaliq_30plus "Gecikmede olan portfel 30+",
kredit_sayi_30plus "Gecikmede olan  say 30+",
umumi_par_30_plus  "30+ Par",
par_ferq_30plus   "Öten ayla muqaise artış 30+",
gec_qaliq_1_30 "Mebleğ gecikme günü 1-30",
gec_qaliq_31_180 "Mebleğ gecikme günü 31-180",
gec_qaliq_181_365 "Mebleğ gecikme günü 181-365",
gecikmede_qaliq_365_plus "Mebleğ gecikme günü 365+",
k_say_1_30 "Kredit sayı gecikme  1-30",
k_say_31_180 "Kredit sayı gecikme  31-180",
k_say_181_365  "Kredit sayı gecikme  181-365",
k_say_365_plus  "Kredit sayı gecikme  365+",
par_1_30 "Par gecikme günü 1-30",
par_31_180 "Par gecikme günü 31-181",
par_181_365 "Par gecikme günü 181-365",
par_365_plus "Par gecikme günü 365+"

 from gecikme_hesabat1 g full outer join  (

select 
nvl(ad,'Total') Filiallar,
nvl(tipi,'Total') Tipi,
umumi_portfel ,
gecikmede_qaliq ,
kredit_sayi,
umumi_par||'%' umumi_par,
umumi_par-umumi_par_evvel||'%' par_ferq,
gecikmede_qaliq_30plus ,
kredit_sayi_30plus ,
umumi_par_30_plus||'%' umumi_par_30_plus ,
umumi_par_30_plus-umumi_par_30_plus_evvel||'%'   par_ferq_30plus,
gec_qaliq_1_30 ,
gec_qaliq_31_180 ,
gec_qaliq_181_365 ,
gecikmede_qaliq_365_plus,
k_say_1_30 ,
k_say_31_180 ,
k_say_181_365  ,
k_say_365_plus  ,
par_1_30 ,
par_31_180 ,
par_181_365 ,
par_365_plus 

from(

select 

 case when e.id in (153,157,158,162) then 'Baş ofis' 
      when e.id in (156,161,168) then 'Best Qazax' else e.name end  ad,
 --e.name ad,
nvl(  d.description , 'Girovsuz') Tipi,

sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 then h.rest+h.duerest end) umumi_portfel,
sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)<>0 then h.rest+h.duerest  end) gecikmede_qaliq,
count(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)<>0 then p.id end   ) kredit_sayi,

nvl(round(sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and  nvl(h.dueday,0)<>0 then h.rest+h.duerest  end)/
 sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 then h.rest+h.duerest end) *100,2),0) Umumi_Par,
  
 nvl(round(sum(case when h.hdate=(select max(hdate) from cm_history where hdate<=ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(:dat1),-1)) and  nvl(h.dueday,0)<>0 then h.rest+h.duerest  end)/
 sum(case when h.hdate=(select max(hdate) from cm_history where hdate<=ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(:dat1),-1)) then h.rest+h.duerest end) *100,2),0) Umumi_Par_evvel,
 
sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)>30 then h.rest+h.duerest  end) gecikmede_qaliq_30plus,

count(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)>30 then p.id end  ) kredit_sayi_30plus,

nvl(round(sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and  nvl(h.dueday,0)>30 then h.rest+h.duerest  end)/
 sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 then h.rest+h.duerest end) *100,2),0) Umumi_Par_30_plus,
 
 nvl(round(sum(case when h.hdate=(select max(hdate) from cm_history where hdate<=ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(:dat1),-1)) and  nvl(h.dueday,0)>30 then h.rest+h.duerest  end)/
 sum(case when h.hdate=(select max(hdate) from cm_history where hdate<=ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(:dat1),-1)) then h.rest+h.duerest end) *100,2),0) Umumi_Par_30_plus_evvel,
 
sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0) between 1 and 30  then h.rest+h.duerest  end) gec_qaliq_1_30,
sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)between 31 and 180 then h.rest+h.duerest  end) gec_qaliq_31_180,
sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)between 181 and 365 then h.rest+h.duerest  end) gec_qaliq_181_365,
sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)>365 then h.rest+h.duerest  end) gecikmede_qaliq_365_plus,
count(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0) between 1 and 30  then p.id  end) k_say_1_30,
count(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)between 31 and 180 then p.id  end) k_say_31_180,
count(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)between 181 and 365 then p.id  end)  k_say_181_365,
count(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)>365 then p.id  end)  k_say_365_plus,
nvl(round(sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0) between 1 and 30  then h.rest+h.duerest  end)/sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1  then h.rest+h.duerest  end)*100,2),0)||'%' Par_1_30,
nvl(round(sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)between 31 and 180 then h.rest+h.duerest  end)/sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1  then h.rest+h.duerest  end)*100,2),0)||'%' Par_31_180,
nvl(round(sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)between 181 and 365 then h.rest+h.duerest  end)/sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1  then h.rest+h.duerest  end)*100,2),0)||'%' Par_181_365,
nvl(round(sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1 and nvl(h.dueday,0)>365 then h.rest+h.duerest  end)/sum(case when h.hdate=:dat1  then h.rest+h.duerest  end)*100,2),0)||'%' Par_365_plus

 from   
 ( select * from
  (select row_number() over (partition by creditid  order by creditid  )rn, c.*  
   from cm_guarantee_credit c ) 
  where rn=1) g,
  cm_portfolio p,
 cm_expert e,
 cm_pledges d,
 cm_history h
 where g.creditid(+)=p.id 
 and e.id(+)=p.expertid 
 and d.id(+)=g.pledgeid
and p.id=h.creditid
 and   h.hdate IN (:dat1,(select max(hdate) from cm_history where hdate<=ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(:dat1),-1)))
 and nvl(h.rest,0)+nvl(h.duerest,0)<>0
 group by ROLLUP(
case when e.id in (153,157,158,162) then 'Baş ofis' 
      when e.id in (156,161,168) then 'Best Qazax' else e.name end,
--e.name,
 nvl(  d.description , 'Girovsuz')) ) where nvl(umumi_portfel,0)<>0
 )  b on g.filial=b.Filiallar and g.tipi=b.Tipi order by idd

datasets.name: ReportInterval
datasets.sql:
select
 p.id ,
case when  c.sex=1 then 'kişi' 
     when  c.sex=2 then 'qadın' else null end cinsi,
 p.initialamount*nvl(p.annualbankrate,0)/100 komision,
 a.description,
  h.penaltyrest,
 -- h.dueday,
  case when   nvl(h.dueday,0) between 1 and 30 then  '1-30 gun'
       when  nvl(h.dueday,0) between 31 and 180 then '31-180 gun'
       when  nvl(h.dueday,0) between 181 and 365 then  '181-365 gun'
       when  nvl(h.dueday,0) >365 then   '365 günden çox'  end gecikme,
       
   (select     case when   nvl(t.dueday,0) between 1 and 30 then  '1-30 gun'
            when   nvl(t.dueday,0) between 31 and 180 then '31-180 gun'
            when   nvl(t.dueday,0) between 181 and 365 then  '181-365 gun'
            when   nvl(t.dueday,0) >365 then   '365 günden çox' end oten_ayda_gecikme 
 from cm_history t where t.creditid=h.creditid and  t.hdate  =ADD_MONTHS(:dat1,-1)-pg_calendar.alti_bazar(ADD_MONTHS(:dat1,-1)) ) oten_ayda_gecikme, 
    (select     case when   nvl(t.dueday,0) between 1 and 30 then  '1-30 gun'
            when   nvl(t.dueday,0) between 31 and 180 then '31-180 gun'
            when   nvl(t.dueday,0) between 181 and 365 then  '181-365 gun'
            when   nvl(t.dueday,0) >365 then   '365 günden çox' end oten_ayda_gecikme  
 from cm_history t where t.creditid=h.creditid and   t.hdate =ADD_MONTHS(:dat1,1)-pg_calendar.alti_bazar(ADD_MONTHS(:dat1,1)) )   novbeti_ayda_gecikme,                
     case when p.dateofconclusion > ADD_MONTHS(:dat1,-1) then 1 else 0 end yeni_kredit,
     case when p.dateofconclusion > ADD_MONTHS(:dat1,-1) then p.initialamount end yeni_kreditin_meblegi,
     case when p.initialamount<=1000 then '1000 manatadek'
           when p.initialamount>1000 then '1000 manatdan çox' end mebleg_qruplari
 from cm_portfolio p,custinfo c,cm_activities a,cm_history h 
  where p.boorowerid=c.idcust
  and a.id=p.activities
  and h.creditid=p.id
  and h.hdate =:dat1-pg_calendar.alti_bazar(:dat1)
  and p.closedate is null
